after_10th.title: After 10th: choosing your path
after_10th.intro: Class 10 is your first big choice, but it does not lock your future. Pick based on what you enjoy and what you are good at, and check the entry rules of the courses you may want later.

options.title: Science (PUC / Class 11-12)
options.who_its_for: Students who like Maths, Physics, Chemistry or Biology.
options.note: Maths is needed for most engineering courses and Biology for medicine, so choose your subject combination with this in mind.

options.title: Commerce
options.who_its_for: Students who like business, numbers and economics.
options.note: Maths is optional in many commerce streams but helps in finance and data roles.

options.title: Arts / Humanities
options.who_its_for: Students who like languages, history, society and ideas.
options.note: A wide set of careers is open here, so do not treat Arts as a lesser choice.

options.title: Polytechnic Diploma
options.who_its_for: Students who want hands-on technical skills early.
leads_to: Lateral entry into the second year of B.E./B.Tech after the diploma (rules vary by state)
options.note: Check admission rules on your state technical education board website.

options.title: ITI and skill courses
options.who_its_for: Students who prefer practical trades and earning sooner.
leads_to: Electrician, fitter, welder and other trades
Further study through bridge or diploma routes where available
options.note: Course lists and rules vary by institute and state.

tips: Choose based on interest first, then marks, then college entry rules.
Talk to seniors and working professionals before you decide.
Take the Interest Guide quiz to get ideas, not final answers.

after_12th.title: After 12th: your options by stream
after_12th.intro: After Class 12 you choose a degree and often an entrance exam. Start with your stream, then look at the careers and exams linked to it.

options.title: Science with Maths (PCM)
options.who_its_for: Students aiming at engineering, technology, architecture or pure science.
leads_to: B.Sc in Maths, Physics, Computer Science or Statistics

options.title: Science with Biology (PCB)
options.who_its_for: Students aiming at medicine and life sciences.
leads_to: B.Sc Nursing and allied health courses

options.title: Commerce
options.who_its_for: Students aiming at finance, accounting and business.

options.title: Arts / Humanities
options.who_its_for: Students aiming at law, civil services, media, teaching and social sciences.
leads_to: Teaching routes such as B.Ed or integrated teacher programmes

options.title: Design routes (any stream in most cases)
options.who_its_for: Creative students who like designing products, visuals or fashion.

tips: Check eligibility on each college website, since rules differ by institute and state.
Apply to a mix of dream, realistic and safe options.
Keep a backup plan, for example CUET along with your main entrance exam.

careers.title: Software Developer
careers.summary: Designs, builds and tests software, apps and websites.
careers.overview: Software developers turn ideas into working programs. The field is broad, covering web, mobile, cloud, games and AI, and many companies hire based on skills and projects as well as degrees.
path: Class 12 with Maths for B.E./B.Tech, or BCA (eligibility varies by university)
B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science or IT, or BCA
Optional: M.Tech or MCA for deeper specialisation
Build projects, do internships and keep a portfolio

careers.title: Civil Engineer
careers.summary: Plans, designs and oversees buildings, roads, bridges and water systems.
careers.overview: Civil engineers shape the physical world around us. Work ranges from design offices to construction sites, and the field includes structures, transport, water and environmental work.
path: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Maths
B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering (4 years)
Work on site or in design; optional M.Tech for specialisation
Gain experience and take on project responsibility

careers.title: Doctor (MBBS)
careers.summary: Diagnoses and treats illness and helps people stay healthy.
careers.overview: Becoming a doctor takes many years of study and training. Doctors can later specialise in areas such as surgery, paediatrics or medicine, or move into research and public health.
path: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Biology
Qualify NEET UG and take part in counselling
MBBS: about 4.5 years of study plus 1 year of internship
Optional: NEET PG for specialisation (MD/MS)

careers.title: Pharmacist
careers.summary: Prepares and dispenses medicines and advises people on using them safely.
careers.overview: Pharmacists work in hospitals, pharmacies, drug companies and research labs. The field mixes chemistry and biology with direct service to patients.
path: Class 12 with PCM or PCB (rules vary by course)
D.Pharm (2 years) or B.Pharm (4 years)
Register with the State Pharmacy Council to practise
Optional: M.Pharm for industry or research roles

careers.title: Chartered Accountant (CA)
careers.summary: Handles accounting, auditing, taxation and financial advice.
careers.overview: CAs are trained and certified by ICAI. They work in audit firms, companies, consulting and their own practice, and the course is demanding but well respected.
path: Register with ICAI for the Foundation level (check current ICAI rules on timing)
Clear Foundation, Intermediate and Final levels
Complete practical training (articleship) with a practising CA
Become a member of ICAI

careers.title: Banking & Finance Professional
careers.summary: Works in banks, investment firms and company finance teams.
careers.overview: Finance careers include bank officers, financial analysts, investment and risk roles. Some are reached through government bank exams, others through an MBA or professional certifications.
path: Class 12 (Commerce helps but is not always required)
B.Com, BBA or any bachelor's degree
Bank exams such as IBPS PO, or an MBA in Finance through CAT and similar exams
Add certifications such as NISM modules or CFA for investment roles

careers.title: UX / UI Designer
careers.summary: Designs apps and websites so they are easy and enjoyable to use.
careers.overview: UX designers research what users need, then design screens and flows to meet those needs. A strong portfolio of real projects matters a lot in this field.
path: Class 12 in any stream (check each design programme)
B.Des through UCEED, NID DAT or other design college entrances
Build a portfolio of real projects
Intern at a product company or design studio

careers.title: Fashion Designer
careers.summary: Creates clothing, accessories and textile designs.
careers.overview: Fashion designers work with brands, export houses or their own labels. Success mixes creativity with an understanding of materials, trends and business.
path: Class 12 in any stream
Entrance exam such as NIFT entrance or NID DAT
Design degree at a fashion or design institute
Internships and portfolio, then brand, export house or own label

careers.title: Lawyer
careers.summary: Advises and represents people and organisations in legal matters.
careers.overview: Lawyers work in courts, law firms, companies and government. You can start right after Class 12 with an integrated degree, or study law after any graduation.
path: Class 12 in any stream
5-year integrated law degree (BA LLB, BBA LLB) through CLAT, AILET or a university entrance, or a 3-year LLB after any graduation
Enrol with a State Bar Council
Clear the All India Bar Examination to practise in courts

careers.title: Civil Services Officer (IAS / IPS and more)
careers.summary: Serves in senior government roles in administration, police, foreign service and other services.
careers.overview: Civil servants are selected through the UPSC Civil Services Examination. You need a bachelor's degree in any subject, so students usually choose a degree they enjoy and prepare alongside it.
path: Complete any bachelor's degree
UPSC Civil Services Exam: Prelims, Mains and Interview
Services include IAS, IPS, IFS and others based on rank and choice
Check age limit and number of attempts on the UPSC notice

careers.title: Research Scientist
careers.summary: Investigates questions in physics, chemistry, biology, maths and related fields.
careers.overview: Scientists work in universities, research institutes and industry labs. The path is long and study-heavy, but fellowships and research programmes support students along the way.
path: Class 12 Science with the relevant subjects
BSc, BS-MS (for example IISER) or B.Tech through IAT, CUET or JEE
MSc or integrated MS
PhD, often funded through fellowships such as those via UGC NET or institute programmes

careers.title: Data Scientist
careers.summary: Uses statistics and programming to find patterns in data and support decisions.
careers.overview: Data scientists work with large datasets in companies, research and government. A good base in maths, statistics and programming matters more than any single degree name.
path: Class 12 with Maths (Statistics or Computer Science helps)
BSc in Statistics, Maths, Computer Science or Data Science, or B.E./B.Tech
Learn Python, SQL, statistics and machine learning through real projects
Optional: MSc or M.Tech for advanced roles

careers.title: Business Manager
careers.summary: Plans, organises and leads teams and operations in a company.
careers.overview: Managers work in areas like operations, marketing, finance and HR. Many people enter management through an MBA after a bachelor's degree, and some choose 5-year integrated programmes right after Class 12.
path: Class 12 in any stream
BBA/BMS or any degree, or a 5-year integrated programme through IPMAT or similar
MBA/PGDM through CAT and similar exams
Start in operations, marketing, finance or consulting and grow into leadership

careers.title: Entrepreneur
careers.summary: Starts and grows a business or startup around an idea.
careers.overview: There is no fixed path to entrepreneurship. Students can begin small while studying, learn from startups and projects, and build skills in selling, building products and managing money.
path: Any stream works
Start small: college clubs, side projects, internships at startups
Study business basics through a degree or short courses
Test your idea with real customers, then think about funding

careers.title: Teacher / Professor
careers.summary: Teaches students in schools or colleges and guides their learning.
careers.overview: Teaching suits people who enjoy explaining ideas and helping others grow. School teaching and college teaching follow different qualification paths.
path: Class 12 in any stream; choose degree subjects you want to teach
Bachelor's degree, then B.Ed, or a 4-year integrated teacher education programme after Class 12
Qualify a teacher eligibility test such as CTET or a state TET for school jobs
For colleges: Master's degree and UGC NET (or PhD)

careers.title: Journalist & Media Professional
careers.summary: Researches, writes and presents news and stories across print, TV and digital media.
careers.overview: Media careers include reporting, editing, video, podcasts and digital content. Practical work, writing samples and internships often matter as much as the degree.
path: Class 12 in any stream
BA in Journalism and Mass Communication, or any degree
Optional: postgraduate diploma or Master's in media
Build writing or video samples through internships and your own projects

exams.name: JEE Main
exams.summary: National entrance for B.E./B.Tech and some architecture and planning courses, and the gateway to JEE Advanced.
exams.eligibility: Class 12 with Physics and Maths (Chemistry or another subject, depending on the paper). Check the official bulletin for current rules.
exams.mode_and_timing: Usually held in the first half of the year, often in more than one session.

exams.name: JEE Advanced
exams.conducted_by: One of the IITs, on rotation
exams.summary: Entrance for admission to the IITs, open only to students who qualify through JEE Main.
exams.eligibility: Top performers in JEE Main, subject to the number of attempts and other rules in the official brochure.
exams.mode_and_timing: Usually held after JEE Main, around mid-year.

exams.name: NEET UG
exams.summary: National entrance for MBBS, BDS, AYUSH and related medical courses.
exams.eligibility: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Biology. Check the official bulletin for age and other rules.
exams.mode_and_timing: Held once a year, usually in the first half of the year.

exams.name: CUET UG
exams.summary: Common entrance for undergraduate admission to central universities and many other participating universities.
exams.eligibility: Class 12 pass or appearing, with subject requirements set by each university and course.
exams.mode_and_timing: Usually held once a year, around mid-year. Check the official schedule.

exams.name: KCET
exams.summary: Karnataka state entrance for engineering, pharmacy, agriculture and other professional courses in the state.
exams.eligibility: Class 12 (PUC) with required subjects, along with Karnataka study and domicile rules. Check the KEA notice.
exams.mode_and_timing: Usually held once a year in the first half of the year.

exams.name: COMEDK UGET
exams.summary: Entrance for admission to engineering seats in participating private colleges in Karnataka.
exams.eligibility: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Maths. Check the official brochure.
exams.mode_and_timing: Usually held once a year, around mid-year.

exams.name: BITSAT
exams.summary: Online entrance for undergraduate programmes at BITS Pilani campuses.
exams.eligibility: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Maths and the minimum marks given in the official notice.
exams.mode_and_timing: Computer-based, usually held in the first half of the year.

exams.name: CLAT UG
exams.summary: Entrance for 5-year integrated law programmes at participating National Law Universities.
exams.eligibility: Class 12 in any stream with the minimum marks stated by the Consortium.
exams.mode_and_timing: Usually held once a year, often towards the end of the year.

exams.name: AILET
exams.summary: Entrance for the 5-year law programme at NLU Delhi.
exams.eligibility: Class 12 in any stream with the minimum marks stated in the official notice.
exams.mode_and_timing: Usually held once a year, often towards the end of the year.

exams.name: UCEED
exams.summary: Entrance for B.Des programmes at IITs and some other institutes.
exams.eligibility: Class 12 in any stream. Check the official brochure for age and attempt rules.
exams.mode_and_timing: Usually held once a year, early in the year.

exams.name: NID DAT
exams.summary: Design aptitude test for admission to design programmes at NID.
exams.eligibility: Class 12 in any stream. Check the official notice for programme rules.
exams.mode_and_timing: Usually has more than one stage, held early in the year.

exams.name: NIFT Entrance
exams.summary: Entrance for fashion, textile and related design programmes at NIFT campuses.
exams.eligibility: Class 12 in any stream for most design programmes. Check the official prospectus.
exams.mode_and_timing: Usually held once a year, early in the year.

exams.name: CAT
exams.conducted_by: Indian Institutes of Management (IIMs), on rotation
exams.summary: Common entrance for MBA/PGDM at IIMs and many other business schools.
exams.eligibility: Bachelor's degree (final-year students can usually apply). Check the official notice for marks rules.
exams.mode_and_timing: Computer-based, usually held once a year towards the end of the year.

exams.name: IPMAT
exams.summary: Entrance for the 5-year integrated management programme at IIM Indore. Similar integrated programmes at other IIMs use other tests such as JIPMAT.
exams.eligibility: Class 12 pass or appearing, with age and marks rules in the official notice.
exams.mode_and_timing: Usually held once a year, around mid-year.

exams.name: UPSC Civil Services Examination
exams.summary: Exam for selection to IAS, IPS, IFS and other central services, with three stages: Prelims, Mains and Interview.
exams.eligibility: Bachelor's degree in any subject, with age limits and attempt limits that you must check in the official notice.
exams.mode_and_timing: Prelims is usually held in the first half of the year, followed by Mains and Interview.

exams.name: CA Foundation
exams.conducted_by: Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI)
exams.summary: First level of the CA course, followed by Intermediate and Final.
exams.eligibility: Registration rules depend on your education level. Check ICAI for current requirements.
exams.mode_and_timing: ICAI conducts exams at regular intervals each year. Check its schedule.

exams.name: IISER Aptitude Test (IAT)
exams.summary: Entrance for the BS-MS dual degree programmes at the IISERs.
exams.eligibility: Class 12 Science with the marks and subjects in the official notice.
exams.mode_and_timing: Usually held once a year, around mid-year.

exams.name: UGC NET
exams.summary: Test for eligibility to become an Assistant Professor and for research fellowships in many subjects.
exams.eligibility: Master's degree or equivalent with the marks given in the official notice.
exams.mode_and_timing: Usually held twice a year.

exams.name: IBPS PO
exams.summary: Recruitment exam for Probationary Officers in participating public sector banks.
exams.eligibility: Bachelor's degree in any stream, with age limits in the official notice.
exams.mode_and_timing: Held in stages once a year. Check the IBPS calendar.

exams.name: NDA & NA Exam
exams.summary: Entrance for the National Defence Academy and Naval Academy, leading to officer careers in the armed forces.
exams.eligibility: Class 12 (Maths and Physics needed for Air Force and Navy wings), with age and fitness rules in the UPSC notice.
exams.mode_and_timing: Usually held twice a year.

exams.name: CTET
exams.summary: Teacher eligibility test for teaching in central government and many other schools.
exams.eligibility: Teacher education qualification as set in the official notice.
exams.mode_and_timing: Usually held once or twice a year.
